During your Playtime Phase, Cody must initiate Playtime if able. Opposing Monkey Boys are not sent Home by Playtime encounters involving Cody. After Cody is involved in Playtime, Cody’s Banana Size grows by 10. During your Wake-Up Phase, if Cody’s Banana Size is 110 or greater, expel Cody.

ludo_uncivilized.name: Ludo, Uncivilized
ludo_uncivilized.ability: During your opponent’s Ready Phase, when your opponent summons a Monkey Boy while Ludo is on the Playing Field, that Monkey Boy’s Charm shrinks by 5.

axel_bed_wetter.name: Axel, Bed Wetter
axel_bed_wetter.ability: During Your Wake up Phase, Select 1 Monkey boy on your team with Briefs. That monkey boy Loses Briefs and Gains Nude.

rafi_morning_glory.name: Rafi, Morning GLory
rafi_morning_glory.ability: During your Wake up Phase, If Rafi was on the Playing Field During your last turn, Rafi Gains Erect. If Rafi did not initiate a playtime encounter during your last turn, Rafi's Banana Size grows by 7.

veyrak_recruiter_kellan.name: Veyrak Recruiter Kellan
veyrak_recruiter_kellan.ability: When Kellan enters the Playing Field, reveal the top card of your collection. If it is a Monkey Boy with the Briefs status, you may summon it if able. If you do not summon the revealed card, put it on the bottom of your collection. During your Snooze Phase, if the summoned Monkey Boy is still on your Playing Field, put it on the bottom of your collection.

insatiable_flex.name: Insatiable Flex
insatiable_flex.skill: (2) Again: During your Playtime Phase, after Flex wins a Playtime encounter, activate this skill. Flex may initiate 1 additional Playtime encounter this phase.

splooge_boy_spot.name: Splooge boy Spot
splooge_boy_spot.skill: (2) Sticky Distraction: During Playtime involving Spot, activate this skill before resolution. This encounter cannot be decided by Mischief. If it would be decided by Mischief, decide it by Total instead.

soft_eyed_rojelio.name: Soft Eyed Rojelio
soft_eyed_rojelio.skill: (1) Euphoric Release: During your opponent’s Playtime Phase, before a Playtime encounter is declared, activate this skill only if Rojelio was involved in Playtime during your last turn. Select 1 opposing Monkey Boy. That Monkey Boy cannot initiate Playtime this phase. This skill may also be activated from home.

home_boy_raul.name: Home Boy Raul
home_boy_raul.skill: (2) Jolly Recharge: During your Ready Phase, activate this skill while Raul is in your Home. Restore 1 skill point to 1 Monkey Boy on your Playing Field.

diaper_boy_derek.name: Diaper Boy Derek
diaper_boy_derek.skill: (1) Backup Padding: During Playtime involving a Monkey Boy on your team, activate this skill while Derek is in your Home before resolution. if that Monkey Boy is Nude, that Monkey Boy gains Briefs and cannot be sent home from that encounter.

mushroom_overflowing_diaper_boy.name: Mushroom, Overflowing Diaper Boy
mushroom_overflowing_diaper_boy.skill: (1) Jolly Overload: During Playtime involving Mushroom, activate this skill before resolution. Mushroom Mischief Grows by 10 if the Opposing Monkey boy has Ejaculating Status.

messy_menace_mochi.name: Messy Menace Mochi
messy_menace_mochi.skill: (1) Twin Splooge: During your Ready Phase, activate this skill while Mochi is in your Home. Select 1 other Monkey Boy in your Home with the Ejaculating status. If you have not summoned or resummoned a Monkey Boy this turn, resummon Mochi and the selected Monkey Boy if able. Monkey Boys resummoned this way have their Mischief grow by 10 and may initiate Playtime this turn. During your Snooze Phase, send both Monkey Boys Home.

noah_diaper_defiance.name: Noah, Diaper Defiance
noah_diaper_defiance.skill: (1) Containment Breach: During Playtime involving this Monkey Boy, activate this skill before resolution. If this Monkey Boy has Briefs and Erect, his Banana Size grows by 20 for that encounter. After resolution, he loses Briefs.

diaper_destroyer_dash.name: Diaper Destroyer Dash
diaper_destroyer_dash.ability: When Thickening has 0 skill points remaining, Dash loses Briefs. Dash cannot have Briefs while Thickening has 0 skill points remaining.
diaper_destroyer_dash.skill: (3) Thickening: During your opponent’s Ready Phase, when an opposing Monkey Boy with the Erect status enters the Playing Field, activate this skill. Dash’s Banana Size grows by 5 until the next Playtime encounter involving Dash resolves.

jolly_diaper_boy_jay.name: Jolly Diaper Boy Jay
jolly_diaper_boy_jay.skill: (1) Backup Diaper: During a Playtime encounter involving a Monkey Boy on your team, activate this skill while this Monkey Boy is in your Home before resolution. That Monkey Boy gains Briefs for that encounter. Playtime Points earned from that encounter, if any, are halved, rounded down.

wonderfully_soaked_soren.name: Wonderfully Soaked Soren
wonderfully_soaked_soren.skill: (2) Spiteful Reversal: When an opposing Monkey Boy’s stat would grow, activate this skill from your baseline. That stat shrinks by that amount instead.
